scope: existing 502 selected positions only; diagnostic cross-fitted copies, never overwrite production
source: original saved source grid and point ID; original source observation recovered by old mapping, gate and stable order
folds: each distinct non-source image with point observations is one witness group, all its repeated rows held out together
mechanical_feasibility: at least 2 distinct construction views including source; witness never source
triangulation: linear multiview normalized DLT from construction rows only; fixed exported COLMAP poses and intrinsics; native observation minus0.5 compared with processed K=A*K_original
registration_and_network: no rerun; all original cameras, intrinsics and VGGT predictions remain fixed and were fitted with full input; conditional observation-level holdout, not statistically independent full-pipeline validation
selection_leakage: 502 support already selected using full data, conditioned on that old selection; no extrapolation to remaining grid or six fallback cases
alignment: reuse original predicted_alignment function/gates; remove witness camera from BOTH predicted camera sets before fitting; full control uses all cameras
gates: retain original min track rows 3, max rows N=5, construction mean common reprojection<=2px, source anchor projection<=2 native px, positive depth, 3D disagreement/source raw Z<=5%; diagnostic DLT must be finite with positive construction depths; do not relax or retry
weights: original alpha=.5 and formula; L/error from construction rows only; raw support excludes source AND witness depth. N remains actual 5 input images, denominators N and N-1 unchanged. Duplicate rows are grouped for splitting but remain rows in frozen L formula; report distinct-view count separately
scoring: mean over witness-image rows of (raw reprojection L2 - copied candidate reprojection L2) using fixed raw witness camera and native pixels; require positive and in-image predictions for both; true visibility/occlusion unverified
full_track_controls: same DLT/gates/formula using all observations/cameras/depth supports and score that same witness
original frozen weighted output scored with same witness; this is resubstitution, NOT heldout
aggregation: source-position means of valid fold scores and independently averaged per-fold GT distances/gain; no averaging 3D candidates and no fold treated as independent sample; expose fold eligibility per position
ranking: within each object x source-image separately, fixed 25/50/100% score ranking, preserve full ties; never allocate across source strata to improve results
controls: same-coverage within-stratum uniform random expectation plus 200 permutations seed42; permute position-level score within each stratum; source-only constant score retains ties and cannot rank within a stratum
evidence_thresholds: stratum must have >=10 evaluable positions and >=5 benefits and >=5 harms for AUROC to count as interpretable; otherwise unavailable/insufficient, still report counts and mean differences
decision_exploratory: limited followup only if BOTH objects have evaluable strata, each object has >=2 interpretable strata, all interpretable strata have positive mean gain above random at BOTH25/50% and no increased harm/good-to-bad rate; require full-reference mean-gain direction consistency. Failure or insufficient class balance must not be called success; not a statistical significance test
GT: offline only, same frozen raw-to-GT similarity and 200000 sampled STL; full existing STL reference and fixed raw ROI sensitivity separate; never used to build copies, score or select folds
